title: UpstreamAuthDescriptor
description: Data-only description of how to obtain and inject credentials for one upstream. Interpreted by one generic engine (src/auth/engine.js) via 'kind' dispatch to a strategy module — never a provider-named code path.

kind.description: Which generic auth strategy interprets this descriptor. New providers reuse an existing kind; a genuinely new *mechanism* (not provider) would add one more strategy module.

inject.description: How the resolved credential is placed on the outbound upstream request.

name.description: Header or query param name, e.g. Authorization, X-Api-Key, api-key, key

static.description: kind=static: credential is the raw secret stored in upstream_credentials.secret_ciphertext, used verbatim.
